title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows

meta.Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Noooooooo!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We failed again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I saw this coming...
But it seems that we're still not able to reach Star Island.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were able to get slightly closer than before, but we couldn't fight that current we encountered...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it was like a rip-roaring tide!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But the Pegasus Special Deluxe Wonder tried super duper hard to fight it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, we're really sticking with that name...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Shunmeiza, Mikazukigumi and the Morinomiya Revue...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was under the impression that we'd grown at least a little after training with such renowned troupes...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cheer up...!
I know you've grown a ton, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I appreciate you saying that...
But that doesn't change the fact that we haven't even been able to catch a glimpse of that island.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means the road to Star Island is going to be a long and treacherous one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we may not be able to cross the sea, but this city may have undergone some changes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also believe that we've all grown after training with those other troupes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, the possibility of changes occurring within SEKAI isn't zero.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Another city might have appeared somewhere without us immediately realizing it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean we'll get to meet lots and lots more new plushies?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That'd be lovely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we try visiting the city?
The plushies there may be able to tell us something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed.
Asking around town seems like an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's get off the ship and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
That part of the harbor seems unusually crowded.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, he's right!
A bunch of plushies are gathered over there! What do you think is going on?
Stop right there! Quit resisting arrest!

rows.Speaker: Monkey Plushie
rows.Line: No, you caught me...!
Alright, now you're going to tell me what you were doing to that tree over there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
That plushie's talking like...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Someone from the Edo period... He is even holding a jitte... Based on his attire, he must be...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A detective.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, he even has an adorable little topknot☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is this happening because of the detective story we did with Mikazukigumi...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's certainly a possibility. However...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They seem to be arguing about something, so why don't we try talking to them for a bit?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... You were chasing after our monkey here because you thought he was doing something to the tree by that ship.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that was all a big misunderstanding?

rows.Speaker: Monkey Plushie
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That tree looked different from usual, so I was just worried...

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I ended up chasing you because I'd convinced myself that you were the culprit.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean about the tree looking different? Can you tell us more?

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line: It looked covered in black and rock hard!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Covered in black... And rock hard...?

rows.Speaker: Detective Plushie
rows.Line:
It'll be faster just to show you...
Come with me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, let's go!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's become black all over...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What happened...?!
All the leaves and branches are wilted!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And these black flecks...
They look like fragments of some kind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, not only that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They sort of resemble fragments of feelings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, they kind of do... But they also seem a little different...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Rui, what do you think we should do about the tree turning all black...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Rui's on that committee that takes care of plants!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tell us what to do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If a plant's roots aren't doing so well, one might adjust the amount of moisture in the soil... But this appears to be a different situation entirely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure if what I know applies to plants in SEKAI, but let's take a closer look and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, Rui, you shouldn't touch it...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa!!
What's happening?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Y-You guys!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_wonder_op1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Even more captivating...
Even more smile-inducing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those kinds of effects...
So, you should think really, really, really hard about this decision! For the sake of you now and you in the future, Rui!
Because I have a feeling that you won't be happy if you don't!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (What was I doing just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This looks like... My directing notes?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
I thought I heard a voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I must've fallen asleep writing down ideas for improvement again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I've grown a lot here at the Center Theatre... But I still have a long way to go as a director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I don't have time to be napping.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(What did I jot down last...?
Ah, here. This must be it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Right. I was working on an effect that involves moving around beneath the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is the scene where the protagonist faces off with the king and makes the decision to betray his country. So...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We could try capturing the audience's attention by using the lights in a clever way when he appears.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a tragic scene, so it might be good to create a few moments where the faces of the characters on stage are darkened to the point where you can't see their expressions...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By switching between light and dark at the right tempo, we should be able to engage the audience's imaginations.
Rui.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
There you are.
Are you still coming up with ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Asahi...?
I thought you'd already gone home.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I knew you'd forgotten.
We've got a party scheduled after practice today, remember?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What party...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, of course.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Alright, now that the stars of tonight's party are here...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Let's wish Asahi and Kamishiro the best of luck when they go over to America's ArcLand! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Still, we weren't expecting you two to be late.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My apologies. I lost track of the time while coming up with ideas for improvement...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: You really do spend every spare minute backstage coming up with ideas, don't you, Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So true! When you're in director mode, you sometimes forget to eat and sleep. But...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: We've been asked to work over in the United States precisely because of your sheer dedication.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm still having trouble processing all that. A part of me is wondering if I'm really the right choice.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line: Hehe. You did only join the Center Theatre a few months ago.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: But even at the Center Theatre, you managed to become a hit director. You being scouted like this makes perfect sense to me.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And the joint performance we did with the American ArcLand team pushed them to pick up the phone.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's no surprise they were impressed. I mean, you had the entire cast float in the air, and you created a giant waterfall using real water.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, those were so much fun!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: I wasn't sure they'd be possible when you first suggested them... But we ended up really enjoying them while performing on stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That show was more or less the culmination of everything that I'd done until then.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The culmination... Yeah, the ideas you came up with were on that level!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And I'm looking forward to seeing what exciting ideas you come up with in the future.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Alright, this seems like a good time to hand you two your bouquets! Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Bouquets...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I wasn't expecting to be given such a nice send-off...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member C
rows.Line: You're joking, right? There was no way we weren't going to celebrate our friends' talents being acknowledged.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Haha. We really appreciate you saying that!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member D
rows.Line:
Hey, you two!
The staff over here want to say hi!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Oh, you're being called over. Go on, you guys!
se_walk_men_002_2
se_walk_men_002_3

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How are you feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Your expression's been stiff for a little while now. You seem really anxious.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm sorry if I'm mistaken, but if you're feeling overwhelmed...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, no... I'm sorry for making you worry so much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm actually fine.
Though, I am feeling a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, we'll be working as members of the Brillia Stage troupe during our time there. I hear that they're constantly looking for the best young actors and directors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm wondering how I'll do as a director.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to seeing what kinds of shows we get to do as a troupe...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Think of it this way... With the two of us joining, the troupe is only going to become even more amazing!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I believe that wherever we go, we can put on the greatest shows imaginable. So...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best when we're in the US, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Many people look forward to seeing the Brillia Stage's performances since they're one of the best troupes in the world...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just as we did when we made countless guests of the Center Theatre smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's put on more spectacular shows in the US.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(ArcLand has parks all around the world...
But the shows they put on in the US stand head and shoulders above the rest...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have no idea if my skills will actually get me anywhere. But...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (To fulfill my dream of producing a show that transcends borders... I need to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to make the absolute most of the kindness they showed me then.)
A few months earlier
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-Is that true, Rui...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You got asked to work at ArcLand...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, Asahi invited me...
And...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's incredible!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Settle down, Tsukasa...
I know how you feel, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, my apologies...
But how am I supposed to keep my voice down in this situation?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ArcLand's troupes are full of the best of the best, and we experienced that firsthand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, Asahi asking you himself must mean... He wants you to direct for the Center Theatre!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If Rui goes to ArcLand, then he'll get one step closer to achieving his dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, since the Center Theatre is one of the best troupes in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There, Rui should be able to take a big step towards making people all around the world smile and laugh with his directing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I knew this could happen...
But to think that it would be so soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, this is your chance to make your dream come true, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be rooting for you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We're probably all feeling a little sad right now.
But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think the same goes for how happy we are about our friend's skills being acknowledged.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, Rui, break a leg...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Nene and Emu are absolutely right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to celebrate you moving up in the world with everything we have! So...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Go make your dream come true, Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I couldn't have asked for better friends...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They want me to make my dream come true and are giving me all these words of encouragement...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which is why, I...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to make my dream a reality.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For their sake. No matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll go and do my best.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Alright, we'll see you guys tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Get home safe!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, let's put on another good show tomorrow!
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: They were all so full of excitement today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. After they threw such a wonderful party for us, we certainly can't allow ourselves to come up short in our new environment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to put on the best shows we can in the US, I'll need to start coming up with more ideas right away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Once I get home, I'll take a look at those videos of the Brillia Stage troupe's old performances...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hey, you should take it easy today.
I mean, we just had a party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, I can't waste a second.
I mustn't stop.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For any reason. Not until I make my dream a reality...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I guess nothing I say will stop you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: No, never mind.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Rui, even when we're over in the States, I promise to make the absolute most of your ideas...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, let's both make our dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to working with you over in the US.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm this way.
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you tomorrow.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're both going to make our dreams come true, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I made Asahi worry quite a bit about me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (While in the US, I have to become a better director, and make my dream...)
But it's gotta feel so lonely when the people you care about aren't there with you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Who was talking just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After I go, I'll get to see them even less than I do now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And we've all been so busy lately that we haven't really been able to keep in touch...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This might be a good time to try contacting them. It's been so long.)

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_wonder_ed1

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_wonder_op2
Mikazukigumi Practice Area
Let's resume practice! Take your positions!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is...)
What's wrong, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry!
Nothing's wrong!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What are you spacing out for, Tsukasa Tenma?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Mikazukigumi's practices are tough enough as it is. Losing focus is completely out of the question!)
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for hesitating. I'm in my spot now...!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line:
Excellent.
Are you ready, Kijima...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line:
Then, we'll start with page fourteen.
The sword fight between Rokuro and Kansuke! Ready...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: Begin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Kijima
rows.Line: *Roar*
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Why, Rokuro?! How could you even think about joining the new government's forces...?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“We swore our lives to the shogun!
Have you forgotten about the vows you made back then...?!”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
“People change with the times...
That is all.”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member B
rows.Line:
Oh, this is good...
Those two just keep getting better at these fights, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member C
rows.Line: Yeah, and they're so fast...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Dodge as he swings down his right arm, shift your weight, pause for a moment, step forward and...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...!
No, I went too far forward. I need to take half a step back!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
(Nicely done, Tenma.
You quickly adjusted your position after making eye contact with me.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (Let's keep this up until the end, and...)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member C
rows.Line:
...!
They're moving even faster now!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member B
rows.Line:
This speed, precision and power...
We all know Kijima's amazing, but Tenma's no slouch either.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (He's moving well.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (I remember him struggling so much with these fights when he first arrived here. He's done an incredible job of improving his skills.)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: (However...)
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Alright, let's take a break here!
We'll resume that same scene in fifteen!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Understood!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Kijima, would it be alright if we went over that fight again a little later?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since I'm playing Kansuke, and you're playing his older brother, Rokuro, I thought we could move around in a way that reflects their feelings better.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
Also, why wait? Let's try that now.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member B
rows.Line:
No, not happening.
You're going to regret it later if you don't rest now.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hmm... True.
If we don't rest properly, then we won't be able to focus as well when we actually practice.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, why don't we do that after we've finished the full rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member C
rows.Line: Hehe. You two sound so excited.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member B
rows.Line:
I mean, I totally understand why.
Not only is this going to be Mikazukigumi's first show to feature two leads...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member B
rows.Line: It's also going to be Tenma's final show with us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and I can't thank you all enough for everything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In the beginning, I had no sense of athleticism, but you all took the time to teach me. In particular, how to become a better swordfighter...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a result, I was able to experience many fun and wonderful things!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: Haha! You've grown so much, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe you'll be training overseas after you leave Mikazukigumi. That's pretty brave of you.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member C
rows.Line: Yeah. If I were you, I'd probably be too scared to go. You've really got a lot of guts.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I'm just doing what I can in order to fulfill my dream of becoming a star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'll have to find a new troupe once I'm in New York, which is going to be an interesting challenge...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member B
rows.Line: Right. You said that you're gonna look for one while attending that acting school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I don't have much of a resume, so I'll need to become better while I'm over there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my quest to become a world-famous star will continue!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to make this final show the culmination of everything I've learned with this troupe. I promise to give it absolutely everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Everything you have, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah...
There's no denying that you've grown at an astonishing pace, but you still have plenty to work on.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: On the other hand, that means you're still nowhere near your ceiling! Let's keep doing our best to perfect our performance.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I want you to hit me with absolutely everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and I hope you'll do the same!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (After I left the Wonder Stage, I've had the chance to train with several different troupes...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

But the fact is that the stronger your feelings are, the greater the impact you'll have on SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I think I understand now.
In layman's terms...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The pain and conflict we endured long ago has come back to help us grow! Does that sound right...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?! How did you arrive on that...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I thought that was the obvious conclusion from the start.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Think about it.
Our tree here grew to this tremendous size after absorbing all those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And from the sound of things, those fragments seem to have represented all of our worst doubts and fears. Which means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to overcome that pain and suffering. No, not just overcome it. We need to turn it into nutrients for growth...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmmm... I sorta get what you're trying to say, but also don't...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe...☆
But it's a super duper great expression of who you are, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's got this bang-boom-zippity-zoom feel to it☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I'll take that as a compliment.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Honestly, you guys are way too positive...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That being said...
I did learn a few things from that dream.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You learned a few things?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though I kept pursuing my dream after we went our separate ways... A lot of things didn't go too well for me on my own.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I realize now just how incredibly important it was for me to stay with you guys and grow together as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
I honestly felt a little relieved when I realized that it was all just a dream...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As interesting a dream as it was.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
When I woke up and saw you guys next to me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I started tearing up a little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Our dreams mean everything to us.
That will never change.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it's nice to have your friends by your side while you're chasing after them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because we make each other stronger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was reminded of just how precious the time we get to spend putting on shows together is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I learned that there are certain lessons and experiences we can only have together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So, let's keep doing everything we can together☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll keep watching over all of you as you try to make your dreams a reality... We'll always be here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we greatly appreciate your support!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, wanna head back and start practicing for that show?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right... I totally forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That dream did sort of make us lose track of time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
Even though we're all back, I still don't feel like I've fully returned...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, why don't we do something to refocus our attention on the task at hand?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like our usual chant. It feels like it's been so long...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that seems like a nice idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Woohoo☆
Then, we'll join you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! With big smiles☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Emu!
You have the honors! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Let's keep trying really hard and doing everything we can together☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready?!
Won-Won-Won-Won...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!
